column1: This file was created using the 202609 CRSP database.
It contains value- and equal-weighted returns for portfolios formed on ME
The portfolios are constructed at the end of June.  BEME is book value at the last fiscal year end of the prior calendar year
divided by ME at the end of December of the prior year. NI (net stock issues)
log of the split-adjusted shares outstanding from the fiscal year-end in t-2 to t-1.
Ac/B (accruals) is the change in operating working capital per split-adjusted share from t-2 to t-1
divided by book equity per split-adjusted share in t-1.
Annual returns are from January to December.
Missing data are indicated by -99.99 or -999.
The break points include utilities and include financials.
The  portfolios  include utilities and include financials.
Average Value Weighted Returns -- Monthly
For portfolios formed in June of year t
Value Weight Average of Net Share Issues Calculated for June of t to June of t+1 as:
Sum[ME(Mth) * NI / Sum[ME(Mth)]
Where Mth is a month from June of t to June of t+1
For portfolios formed in June of year t
Value Weight Average of Accruals Calculated for June of t to June of t+1 as:
Sum[ME(Mth) * AC/B / Sum[ME(Mth)]
Where Mth is a month from June of t to June of t+1
